source_fit_rows.expression: and I think stress caused it
source_fit_rows.source_population: 14 young women diagnosed with premature ovarian insufficiency (aged 26-39 years at assessment) interviewed in Persian in Iran
source_fit_rows.family_population: 25-year-old English-speaking woman with previously regular 28-day periods whose last period started 7 months ago
source_fit_rows.note: Same young-adult female secondary-amenorrhea / ovarian-insufficiency domain attributing amenorrhea to stress ('some women believed stress caused their POI'), adapted from diagnosed Persian-speaking participants aged 26-39 years in Iran to an undiagnosed 25-year-old English speaker ('and I think stress caused it').
